title: A Registry Study on long-term-outcome of large vessel vasculitis
summary: In this registry, the course of the disease and the possible recurrence of inflammation in patients with inflammation of the large vessels (large vessel vasculitis) will be recorded in order to identify possible risk factors.

interventions.name:
Observational study - 1 arm
Type of large vessel vasculitis
Age at first manifestation
CRP, ESR and Hb values at initial diagnosis
Recurrence during follow-up
Systemic inflammatory response index

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
age > 18
confirmed large vessel vasculitis
Exclusion criteria:
age < 18
other, secvondary vasculitis
